function.name: get_air_quality
function.description: Retrieve real-time air quality and pollution data for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the air quality data for.

detail.description: If true, additional data like PM2.5, PM10, ozone levels, and pollution sources will be retrieved. the value is set to false to default.

historical.description: Optional date (in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format) to retrieve historical data.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "紐約市的空氣質量數據是什麼，包括今天、昨天和前天的額外數據，如PM2.5、PM10、臭氧水平和污染源？今天是2023年5月5日。"

We need to retrieve real-time air quality data for New York City for today (2023-05-05), yesterday (2023-05-04), and the day before (2023-05-03). The user wants additional data like PM2.5, PM10, ozone levels, and pollution sources. We have a function get_air_quality that can retrieve data. It accepts location, detail boolean, historical date string. We need to call it for each date. The function signature: get_air_quality({location: string, detail?: boolean, historical?: string}). The default historical is "today". So we need to call with historical "2023-05-05", "2023-05-4", "2023-05-03". Also detail true.

We need to call the function three times. The user wants all data. We should combine results. The function returns any. We'll call it.
